blocks.raw: # Create a Loyalty Promotion
blocks.text: Create a Loyalty Promotion

blocks.raw: Creating a loyalty promotion is a structured process that translates your business objective into a functional configuration. The following steps will guide you through defining the promotion's metadata, audience, and earning activities, as well as applying optional limits and advanced settings to fine-tune its behavior
blocks.text: Creating a loyalty promotion is a structured process that translates your business objective into a functional configuration. The following steps will guide you through defining the promotion's metadata, audience, and earning activities, as well as applying optional limits and advanced settings to fine-tune its behavior

blocks.raw: # **Step 1: Defining the promotion details**
blocks.text: Step 1: Defining the promotion details

blocks.raw: Start by defining the promotion's basic details, such as its name, description, duration, and the loyalty program it belongs to.
blocks.text: Start by defining the promotion's basic details, such as its name, description, duration, and the loyalty program it belongs to.

blocks.raw:
1. Go to the **Promotions** tab under **Loyalty+**.

2. Select **Create Promotion**.

3. In the **Promotion Name** box, enter a unique name. The character limit for the promotion name is 255 characters.

   <Callout icon="👍" theme="okay">
     ### Tip

     Use a consistent naming convention for easier analysis. A recommended format is `[Timeframe]_[Audience]_[Offer]_[Objective]`, for example, `Q4-2025_GoldTier_2xPoints_ProductLaunch`.
   </Callout>

   <Image src="https://files.readme.io/fbf744e2787668f08624e76c1e63092e3feac58cf8c7b2e705f1cd78d6f90ce1-image.png" width="80%" border={true} />

4. *(Optional)* In the **Description** box, outline the business case or key configuration details. The character limit for description is 1000 characters.

5. From the **Program** dropdown, select a [loyalty program](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/features-of-loyalty#/). Link a loyalty program to include its customers and apply its strategies. This step is required for organisations with [multiple loyalty programs](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-multi-loyalty-program) (MLP).

6. From the **Timezone** dropdown, select a time zone. This is the time zone where the loyalty promotion was created. Add more time zone tags in organization settings.

   <Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
     ### Note

     This information is for reference only. The system always displays information in the organization time zone.
   </Callout>

7. In the **Duration of the promotion** box, select the start and end date and time. The promotion operates in your organization's time zone.
   <Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
     ### Note

     If you do not provide a time along with the date, the times will default to 00:00 and 23:59 (start of the day to end of the day).
   </Callout>

8. Under **Promotion type**, select a [type](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#objective).

9. In the **Promotion external identifier** box, enter a unique ID for tracking and reporting. The character limit for the promotion name is 255 characters.

10. Select **Next**.

blocks.raw: # **Step 2: Defining who is eligible (Enrolment)**
blocks.text: Step 2: Defining who is eligible (Enrolment)

blocks.raw: Specify which customers are eligible to join this promotion. You can either enrol loyalty members, non-loyal members, all members or target a specific segment of members.
blocks.text: Specify which customers are eligible to join this promotion. You can either enrol loyalty members, non-loyal members, all members or target a specific segment of members.

blocks.raw: ## Option 1: Enrol loyal members
blocks.text: Option 1: Enrol loyal members

blocks.raw: Select **Loyal members** to target customers who are already actively participating in your loyalty program. This option allows you to utilize the full range of promotion features, including all activity types and reward actions.
blocks.text: Select Loyal members to target customers who are already actively participating in your loyalty program. This option allows you to utilize the full range of promotion features, including all activity types and reward actions.

blocks.raw: ## Option 2: Enrol non-loyal members
blocks.text: Option 2: Enrol non-loyal members

blocks.raw: Select **Non-loyal members** to target customers who are not yet part of the loyalty program This can be used for customer acquisition campaigns.
blocks.text: Select Non-loyal members to target customers who are not yet part of the loyalty program This can be used for customer acquisition campaigns.

blocks.raw: **Note:** When targeting non-loyal members, the following promotion capabilities are restricted to ensure compatibility with non-member profiles:
blocks.text: Note: When targeting non-loyal members, the following promotion capabilities are restricted to ensure compatibility with non-member profiles:

blocks.raw:
* **Opt-in:** Opt-in criteria cannot be configured.
* **Activities:** Milestone and Streak-based activities are not supported; you can only configure **Single** activities.
* **Rewards:** You can only [send a communication message](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-actions#send-communication), add a tag for the member or [update the members' status](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-actions#update-member-status); you cannot issue points or coupons or other incentives to non-loyal members.

blocks.raw: ## Option 3: Enrol all members of the program
blocks.text: Option 3: Enrol all members of the program

blocks.raw: Select **All members of the program** for broad promotions where every member, loyal and non-loyal is eligible to participate.
blocks.text: Select All members of the program for broad promotions where every member, loyal and non-loyal is eligible to participate.

blocks.raw: **Note:** As this option includes non-loyal members, specific restrictions apply based on the activity type configured:
blocks.text: Note: As this option includes non-loyal members, specific restrictions apply based on the activity type configured:

blocks.raw:
* **Single activities:** You can only send a communication message, add a tag for the member or update the members' status; you cannot issue points or coupons or other incentives to non-loyal members. All other actions are supported only for loyal members.
* **Milestone and streak activities:** These activity types and their associated actions are supported only for loyal members.

blocks.raw: ## Option 4: Enrol specific members
blocks.text: Option 4: Enrol specific members

blocks.raw: Choose this to create a targeted promotion for a specific audience. These audiences can be:
blocks.text: Choose this to create a targeted promotion for a specific audience. These audiences can be:

blocks.raw:
* A specific [audience group](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-audience-group#/) or
* A set of customers who are enrolled if they complete an [activity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#member-activities) or
* A set of customers who are enrolled via the [enrol API](https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/enrol-loyalty-promotion), which functions as the external trigger for the promotion. This API call can be initiated from various sources, such as a customer journey, a mobile app promotion, or a third-party CRM.

blocks.raw: # **Step 3: Defining how members join (Optional opt-in)**
blocks.text: Step 3: Defining how members join (Optional opt-in)

blocks.raw: Once you have defined the audience eligible for enrolment, you can configure the opt-in criteria. This adds a required step where customers must perform an explicit action to signal their interest before they can participate in the promotion. This is essential for ensuring active engagement, as only customers who have consciously opted in will be able to earn rewards. You can define the opt-in criteria by requiring customers to complete an **Opt-in Activity** or by opting them in via an **External trigger**, such as an API call.
blocks.text: Once you have defined the audience eligible for enrolment, you can configure the opt-in criteria. This adds a required step where customers must perform an explicit action to signal their interest before they can participate in the promotion. This is essential for ensuring active engagement, as only customers who have consciously opted in will be able to earn rewards. You can define the opt-in criteria by requiring customers to complete an Opt-in Activity or by opting them in via an External trigger, such as an API call.

| Opt-in method        | Use case                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Activity based**   | Require customers to perform an action to join, such as downloading the mobile application.                                                                                                                                       |
| **External trigger** | Manage enrolment through the [opt-in API](https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/enrol-loyalty-promotion) that can be initiated from various sources, such as a customer journey, a mobile app promotion, or a third-party CRM. |

blocks.raw: # **Step 4: Defining earning activities**
blocks.text: Step 4: Defining earning activities

blocks.raw: This is the core of your promotion. Here, you define what actions customers must take to earn rewards. You can define an [individual activity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-creating-a-loyalty-promotion#option-1-define-an-individual-earning-activity) or a [group of activities](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-creating-a-loyalty-promotion#option-2-define-a-group-of-earning-activities). You can add up to 25 individual activities and up to 10 groups and sub-activities in a group, per loyalty promotion. You can add up to 10 brand actions per activity.
blocks.text: This is the core of your promotion. Here, you define what actions customers must take to earn rewards. You can define an individual activity or a group of activities. You can add up to 25 individual activities and up to 10 groups and sub-activities in a group, per loyalty promotion. You can add up to 10 brand actions per activity.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Note

  If you configured enrolment or opt-in tracking in Steps 2 and 3, you can filter earning activity rewards based on those values. In the qualifying condition builder, select **Member attributes**, then choose **Enrolment Values** or **Optin Values** to access tracking fields such as **Notes** and **Reason**. Supported operators: **matches all of**, **matches any of**, **is not in**.

  The system shows an **Enrolment mapping does not exist** validation error if you reference a tracking field that was not configured on the promotion.
</Callout>

blocks.raw: ## Option 1: Define an individual earning activity
blocks.text: Option 1: Define an individual earning activity

blocks.raw: Choose this for straightforward promotions where a reward is tied to a single customer action. First, decide which [type of activity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#member-activities) best fits your promotion's goal:
blocks.text: Choose this for straightforward promotions where a reward is tied to a single customer action. First, decide which type of activity best fits your promotion's goal:

blocks.raw:
* **Single**: A customer qualifies for the promotion by performing a one-time action, such as updating their profile.
* **Milestone**: A customer qualifies for the promotion by reaching a cumulative goal, such as making a total transaction of $200 or more in a month.
* **Streak**: A customer qualifies for the promotion by completing a repeated action, such as spending $100 or more once a week for three consecutive weeks.

blocks.raw: ### **To configure a milestone activity**
blocks.text: To configure a milestone activity

blocks.raw:
1. Select **Activity**.

2. Select **Milestone-based**.

3. From the **Actions** dropdown, select the [member action](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#member-actions).

4. *(Optional)* Select **Add qualifying condition** and define a specific [qualifying condition](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#qualifying-conditions-and-attributes) for the action. You can add multiple qualifying conditions if required. You can use the search tool to search for a specific value when available.

   **Note**: When providing values for SKUs, you can also upload a .csv file that includes all the values. Select Upload SKUs to upload the .csv file.

5. Under **achieves a Milestone**, define the [target entity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/milestones-new-flow#tracking-configurations), [target type](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/milestones-new-flow#tracking-configurations), and target value that the customer must reach.

6. *(Optional)* To create a recurring challenge, select **Add Cycles** and configure the [reset period](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-limits#loyalty-promotion-limits-reset-period).
   1. Select the cycle duration type from the dropdown. This defines how often a cycle resets. You can either choose a defined recurring cycle (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly), a custom cycle, or on target achievement.
   2. Select the cycle start date from the dropdown. This defines when a cycle starts for a customer. You can choose to start on the promotion start date, from the customer’s first activity, or on a specific date.

7. *(Optional)* Select **Upload Individual Customer Targets** from the three-dot menu to upload a `.csv` file. You can then upload a `.csv` file containing the target cycle values for each customer. You can download a sample `.csv` file from [here](https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/tesseract/ui/uploadCustomersSample.csv).

   <Image src="https://files.readme.io/c75d09730ace334dd7b1a58d8eb9b388e0ecaf33b734c47dbefbd6400b4885c1-image.png" width="80%" border={true} />

8. *(Optional)* Select **Upload Individual Member Targets** from the three-dot menu to enable [leaderboard](https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/leaderboards) tracking for the milestone.

9. Select **+ Add brand actions** to configure the incentive.

10. Select **Next**.

blocks.raw: ### **To configure a streak activity**
blocks.text: To configure a streak activity

blocks.raw:
1. Select **Activity**.

2. Select **Streak-based**.

3. From the **Actions** dropdown, select the [member action](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#member-actions).

4. Select **Add qualifying condition** and define a specific [qualifying condition](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#qualifying-conditions-and-attributes) for the action. You can add multiple qualifying conditions if required.  You can use the search tool to search for a specific value when available.

   **Note**: When providing values for SKUs, you can also upload a `.csv` file that includes all the values. Select Upload SKUs to upload the `.csv` file.

5. Under **achieves a Streak**, defines the [target entity](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/milestones-new-flow#tracking-configurations), [target type](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/milestones-new-flow#tracking-configurations), target value, period, the number of times the action must be completed, and the time period (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or a custom duration). For example, enter the following to create a transaction streak of four times per week for a gross amount of $20: `transaction, gross amount, $20, weekly, 4 times, consecutively`.

6. *(Optional)* Select **Add custom duration** and define a custom cycle duration for the streak. This is applicable for a custom streak duration.
   1. Select **+ Add duration** and define the cycle durations.
   2. Select the **Upload duration** radio button to upload a `.csv` file that includes the custom durations.
   3. Select **Done** to save the changes.

      <Image src="https://files.readme.io/650ac5fbd50492049584bb55228fc8c312df728d0a7b9768d2cea729fddc59c7-image.png" width="80%" border={true} />

7. Select **+ Add brand actions** to configure the incentive.

8. Select **Next**.

blocks.raw: ## Option 2: Define a group of earning activities
blocks.text: Option 2: Define a group of earning activities

blocks.raw: Choose this for more complex promotions where customers must complete multiple actions. You can require them to complete all activities (an "AND" condition) or just a certain number of them (an "OR" condition).
blocks.text: Choose this for more complex promotions where customers must complete multiple actions. You can require them to complete all activities (an "AND" condition) or just a certain number of them (an "OR" condition).

blocks.raw: #### **To configure a group of earning activities:**
blocks.text: To configure a group of earning activities:

blocks.raw:
1. Select **Group of Activities**.
2. Select the **earning condition** for the group:
   * **All:** The customer must complete *all* defined activities to earn the reward.
   * **Any:** The customer must complete a specific number of activities from the group. If you select this, also select the required number from the dropdown.
3. From the **Add Item** dropdown, begin building your group by adding one or more of the following:
   * Select **Add Sub Activity** to add an individual earning rule to the group.
   * Select **Add Sub Group** to create a nested group with its own **All** or **Any** condition for even more complex logic.
4. From the **actions** dropdown, select the [member action](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#member-actions).
5. Select **Add qualifying condition** and define a specific [qualifying condition](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#qualifying-conditions-and-attributes) for the action. You can add multiple qualifying conditions if required.
6. Under **achieves a Milestone**, define the target value the customer must reach (for example, enter `500` for a goal of $500).
7. *(Optional)* To create a recurring challenge, select **Add Cycles** and configure the [cycles](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#cycles-in-milestone-based-promotions) ([reset period](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-limits#loyalty-promotion-limits-reset-period)).
   1. Select the cycle duration type from the dropdown. This defines how often a cycle resets. You can either choose a defined recurring cycle (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly), a custom cycle, or on target achievement.
   2. Select the cycle start date from the dropdown. This defines when a cycle starts for a customer. You can choose to start on the promotion start date, from the customer’s first activity, or on a specific date.
8. Select **+ Add brand actions** to configure the incentive.
9. Select **Next**.

blocks.raw: # **Step 5: Defining the promotion limits (Optional)**
blocks.text: Step 5: Defining the promotion limits (Optional)

blocks.raw: Set overall [limits](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-core-concepts#limits) to control your budget and manage the promotion's scale. These are different from the enrolment and opt-in limits defined in earlier steps.
blocks.text: Set overall limits to control your budget and manage the promotion's scale. These are different from the enrolment and opt-in limits defined in earlier steps.

blocks.raw: ## To add and define limits:
blocks.text: To add and define limits:

blocks.raw:
1. Select **Add now** to create a new limit.

2. Define the limit rules, for example:

   * Cap the total rewards a single customer can earn from this promotion.
   * Limit the number of times a qualifying activity can be performed for a reward.

3. Select **+Add [reset period](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions-limits#loyalty-promotion-limits-reset-period)** to make the limit recurring within a specific timeframe. For example, by selecting **Past X Days** and entering **10**, the limit will reset every 10 days, checking the customer's activity only within that rolling window.

4. After you have finished configuring the limits, select **Next**.

   <Image src="https://files.readme.io/c913dc4a3d984961c433a5078f7ca9caa3806bb29e79c595f0fc63401fe06d86-image.png" width="80%" border={true} />

blocks.raw: # **Step 6: Configuring additional settings (Optional)**
blocks.text: Step 6: Configuring additional settings (Optional)

blocks.raw: You can configure settings for internal operations and reporting, such as associating a [till code](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/store-hierarchy#/add-till), adding custom promotion attributes for tracking, or defining the liability split for shared promotions.
blocks.text: You can configure settings for internal operations and reporting, such as associating a till code, adding custom promotion attributes for tracking, or defining the liability split for shared promotions.

blocks.raw: To configure the additional settings, follow these steps:
blocks.text: To configure the additional settings, follow these steps:

blocks.raw:
1. Select a till code from the dropdown or enter a till code to associate with the loyalty promotion. All points allocated on promotion achievement will be tagged to the selected till. This is applicable when the promotion type is **Milestone **or **Streak.**
2. Enable the **Allow member events before enrolment for benefit issual** toggle to issue incentives to customers for activities they performed before they enrolled in the loyalty promotion.
3. Enable the **Specify promotion attributes** toggle to configure promotion attribute custom fields for the loyalty promotion. To add a promotion attribute, go to **Old promotion** > **Promotion settings** > **Custom fields** > **New custom field**.
4. Select **Edit** to define the liability split for the loyalty promotion, select **Add liability owner**, and select a new liability partner from the dropdown. This feature serves primarily as metadata for accounting and reconciliation purposes and does not affect the customer's experience or the logic of the promotion itself.
5. Select **Done** to save the changes.
